about_the_game:
The AstroScaper demo gives you a first look at our cozy, minimalist puzzle city-builder. You’ll build colonies on asteroids using proximity-based mechanics and light resource management, all wrapped in a calm sci-fi atmosphere.

This demo includes:

  • Expedition Mode (preview) - Plan your colony carefully, earn points from synergies, and reach score thresholds and custom objectives to achieve expedition goals.
  • Freebuild Mode - Relax and experiment on a selection of preset asteroid seeds. No pressure, no timers - just creative city-building in space.
  • Procedurally generated environments (limited) - Try a sample of unique asteroid layouts to get a feel for the full game’s variety.
  • Core building set - Experiment with a reduced roster of structures designed to highlight the main mechanics.


Not included in this demo:

  • Challenge Mode (weekly maps & leaderboards).
  • Full building roster and all environment presets.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 560 Ti
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: Dual Core 3.4 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM

short_description: AstroScaper is a minimalist puzzle city-builder where every placement counts. Build colonies on asteroids using strategic proximity-based mechanics and minimal resource management. Relax in freebuild mode or chase high scores in challenge mode – all against a serene cosmic backdrop.
